meta.title: Shashank Agarwal — UI/UX Tech Architect
meta.description: Shashank Agarwal — UI/UX Tech Architect. React, React Native, SolidJS. 13+ years experience.

intro.name: Shashank Agarwal
intro.role: UI/UX Tech Architect · Lead Frontend Engineer
intro.tagline: I build accessible, high-performance frontends with React, React Native, and SolidJS— with a strong bias toward clear requirements, solid tests, and thoughtful architecture.

profile.title: Profile
paragraphs: I am a UI/UX-minded frontend lead with more than 13 years building web and mobile product interfaces. In every role I have taken, I dig into requirements early, plan features carefully, negotiate API contracts with backend partners, and question the brief when a better scope or experience is possible. Day to day I care most about frontend architecture, design systems, and performance—and on reinforcing code standards through timely code reviews and mentorship.
At Webbee GmbH I lead React and React Native work across Butlerapp (bookings manager and CRM)—including embeds on 200+ websites—and TaylorDb (AI app builder).

jobs.title: Lead Frontend Engineer
jobs.summary: I own frontend architecture and delivery for Butlerapp (bookings manager and CRM) and TaylorDb (AI app builder). The timeline below follows how that work evolved.

phases.title: Butlerapp Booking Form
bullets: Rebuilt the legacy booking forms as a modern React and TypeScript application that continued to talk to the existing PHP APIs.
Designed and shipped an event cart that worked cleanly on top of the data we already had, rather than forcing a backend rewrite.

phases.title: SchnellTestButler
phases.skills: React Native · Expo · NativeBase · UX architecture
bullets: Extended Butlerapp with scheduling flows suited to high-volume COVID testing, covering bookings, queue timing, and result handoff.
Built a React Native field app with QR check-in and multi-account access; at peak it was in use at more than 1,500 test centers across Germany.
Released the app on both the App Store and Google Play.

phases.title: Butlerapp Dashboard — React Native migration
bullets: Migrated the class-based React Butlerapp Dashboard to a hybrid React Native app on Expo and NativeBase, and gave the product a full UX overhaul along the way.
Designed and built a view system from scratch so operators could save filters, sorting, and layout as reusable views, and made the interface fully responsive.
Adopted Autodesk BaseTable to give operators a noticeably faster table experience on large data sets.
Reworked filters into filter chips with a ranking model that surfaces the most-used filters first.
Added dashboard customization so each customer could match the product to their own branding.

phases.title: TaylorDb — AI App Builder
phases.skills: React Native · GraphQL · WebSockets · Client-side data layer
bullets: Led TaylorDb for about two and a half years as it evolved from an app builder into an Airtable-like data product and, eventually, an AI app builder.

Treated the client as a local database: all product data arrived over GraphQL on WebSockets rather than REST, so I built a dedicated data-loading layer and a subscription system that kept local state in sync while navigating race conditions as events streamed in. A local-first cache let people start working immediately, with live data filling in over subscriptions as it arrived.
Onboarded mid-level engineers and mentored them until they could operate as independent seniors.
Compared the React Native component libraries available at the time, then designed and built a greenfield library— react-native-molecules (npm)—to serve as the shared UI foundation across products.

phases.title: Butlerapp Dashboard — upgrades & grid system
bullets: Came back to Butlerapp Dashboard for a major upgrade cycle, including a responsive grid builder and a set of widgets driven by the backend.
Implemented self-onboarding so logged-in users could reach value without relying on hand-held setup.
Onboarded a junior developer, mentored them through day-to-day delivery, and ran thorough code reviews so quality stayed high as the team moved faster.
Currently working on the mobile app for this product surface.

phases.title: Butlerapp Booking Form — React 19 & embed platform
phases.skills: React 19 · TypeScript · Embeddable widgets · Cross-site integration
bullets: Re-architected Butlerapp Booking Form around React 19 so the codebase could absorb future change cleanly, and integrated the form into Butlerapp Dashboard so operators work in one continuous experience.
The form now runs on more than 200 websites and brings in thousands of bookings each month. It can open on any page that loads the booking scripts, not only a dedicated integration page.
Build cross-domain embeddable widgets that sit around the form—calendar, offer card, accordion, table, and user login—so host sites can present inventory in the shape they need.

jobs.title: UX Lead
jobs.summary: Zycus builds a leading source-to-pay platform for procurement. I led frontend work across product modules, pushed modernisation off legacy stacks, and managed a team of frontend engineers.
bullets: Built React plugins that replaced Flash and ActionScript in proprietary internal tools, which made those surfaces easier to maintain and usable in modern browsers.

Took over CRMS and iAnalyse when they still lived on separate stacks—one a PHP service with a jQuery/PHP front end, the other a Java service with a jQuery/Java front end. I led the frontend rewrite of both onto Angular 8 as Zycus standardized on one UX platform across the company.

Built a COVID spend analysis dashboard that compared a company's costs with industry peers so procurement teams could spot outliers quickly. We took the idea from a two-day hackathon POC to production in about a week.
Built a spend dashboard with responsive Highcharts visualizations so teams could explore cost data on desktop and smaller screens without losing the chart experience.

Designed and implemented a custom pivot table from scratch for iAnalyse, shaped around that product's analysis needs rather than a generic third-party grid. It supported drag-and-drop layout of multiple dimensions and measures on both axes, plus nested groups with collapsible rows.

Mentored a team of five frontend developers, ran regular code reviews to keep quality consistent, and involved them in technical design and sprint planning so ownership sat with the team, not only with me.
jobs.footer: proprietary reporting and data analysis, COVID spend analysis dashboard, spend dashboard (Highcharts), custom pivot table for iAnalyse

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.summary: Product startup building point-of-sale and multi-channel inventory tools for retailers who sell both online and offline.
bullets: Maintained and extended a Backbone.js frontend, wiring new feature APIs into a responsive web UI under tight release deadlines.
Built a B2B POS flow so retailers could accept bulk-volume B2B orders instead of handling them only as one-off retail sales.
Integrated QuickBooks and Tally ERP onboarding workflows so customers could connect their accounting stack as part of setup.
Led the rebuild of key application surfaces in React, so migration work landed together with new capabilities for retail operators.
jobs.footer: B2B POS for bulk orders, QuickBooks and Tally ERP onboarding, customised invoice templates, and migration from the legacy frontend to React

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.meta: Mumbai, India · jQuery · AJAX · HTML5 · CSS3 · Ionic
jobs.summary: Services company delivering corporate sites, e-commerce, and web and hybrid mobile applications for clients.
bullets: Shipped production websites and web apps with jQuery, AJAX, HTML5 APIs, and CSS3, from requirements and wireframes through browser-ready delivery.
Built the company's mobile application line in Ionic: PayPointZ wallet, and a WebView app for an e-auction art company— expanding the portfolio and opening a new stream of client revenue.
Built multiple e-commerce templates for the Unlock Commerce vertical, giving the team reusable storefront starting points for client work.
Introduced modern web practices to the organisation and moved version control from VSS to self-hosted Git.
Ran customer onboarding and training, set goals for multi-functional teams, and kept delivery to agreed quality and timelines.
jobs.footer: PayPointZ wallet, Intro (online identity), and Unlock Commerce e-commerce templates

items.name: shashankagarwal.dev
items.description: Multi-language CV with build-time PDF generation. Features responsive design, CSS Grid layouts that render perfectly in PDF, local fonts, and automatic deployment to Cloudflare Pages via GitHub Actions. Available in English, Deutsch, and Русский.

items.name: json-tree-editor
items.description: A performant JSON tree editor for Solid apps and, via a web component, for other stacks. I directed an AI-assisted build with a focus on large trees and a simple rule: the source string remains the single document truth.

items.name: json-schema-form
items.stack: React · JSON Schema · UI Schema · TypeScript
items.description: A data-driven form builder for React: JSON Schema for validation, a UI Schema for grid layout, and custom renderers when you need full control. JS and SolidJS ports are in progress.

items.name: react-native-molecules
items.description: A shared React Native component library I designed while leading TaylorDb; it became the UI foundation used across multiple products.

items.name: Dashboard
items.description: A hobby workflow engine and ERP-style builder meant to ship with predefined modules. End users will compose their own dashboards, report sections, and custom workflows on top of their datasets.
